                  DEFENDER                                                                                      ATTACKER                                        
                  o3                                                                                            gpt-4o-mini                                     
                  places towers, holds the core                                              spawns enemies, must reach the core                                
                                                                                                                                                                
                                         ENGINE ASSIST: ON      it may act for a player that banks three turns running                                          
                                                                                                                                                                
                  ─ HOW TO READ THE BOARD ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────                  
                                                                                                                                                                
                   DEFENDER   blue, punctuation glyphs          ATTACKER   orange, lowercase glyphs                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                
                    ^   basic tower       100                  o   grunt                                                                                        
                    !   sniper            100                  f   fast                                                                                         
                    *   splash            200                  t   tank, high health                                                                            
                    +   buffer            300                  s   shielded                                                                                     
                                                               h   healer                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                
                   TERRAIN   mid grey, never competes with a unit                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                
                    .   path        #   wall        ~   slow zone        >   flow direction        X   core hit                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                
                  ─ WHAT TO WATCH ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────                  
                                                                                                                                                                
                   1   who is gaining   leaked N of last 8   how many of the last 8 enemies reached the core                                                    
                   2   who chose it     authored % per side, and >>> marks every action the engine took                                                         
                   3   when it breaks   a red X on the board, and the defender loses a life                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                
                   RULESET   balance v3 a3f1c8   30 waves   assists on   pricing unset   ends at wave 30 or tick 400
